[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested famous artists known for landscape paintings, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. J.M.W. Turner (1775-1851) - British Romantic painter known for dramatic seascapes and landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Claude Monet (1840-1926) - French Impressionist master of capturing light and color in gardens and landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. John Constable (1776-1837) - English Romantic painter famous for depictions of the English countryside.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Frederic Edwin Church (1826-1900) - American Hudson River School painter known for dramatic landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Caspar David Friedrich (1770-1840) - German Romantic painter known for symbolic landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Thomas Gainsborough (1727-1788) - English Rococo painter known for blending realism with fantasy in landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Albert Bierstadt (1830-1902) - German-American painter known for majestic depictions of the American West.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Camille Pissarro (1830-1903) - French Impressionist painter focusing on rural scenes and cityscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Asher B. Durand (1796-1886) - American painter known for realistic landscapes of the American wilderness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Paul Cézanne (1839-1906) - French Post-Impressionist painter who revolutionized landscape depiction.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested famous artists known for abstract landscapes, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mark Rothko (1903-1970) - His works evoke the natural world through abstracted forms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Helen Frankenthaler (1928-2011) - Created vibrant, lyrical paintings referencing the natural world.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Richard Diebenkorn (1922-1993) - Known for abstracted landscapes in his "Ocean Park" series.
